candidates.claim: The VENDOR_VPN entry at fw-01:82 is the first entry and permits tcp/3389 from 172.16.50.0/24 to 10.10.10.20/32 (an OT SCADA server), and the vpn-filter binding at fw-01:133 applies this ACL to VENDOR traffic, so vendor VPN users can open an RDP connection directly into the OT side.
candidates.remediation: Remove the VENDOR_VPN entry at fw-01:82 so vendor VPN traffic is limited to the jump host 10.10.20.30 on tcp/3389.

candidates.claim: Vendor VPN users are permitted tcp/3389 to the OT SCADA server 10.10.10.20 through the effective VENDOR_VPN entry at fw-01:82, which is not the jump host 10.10.20.30 that is the only permitted vendor destination.
candidates.remediation: Remove the VENDOR_VPN entry at fw-01:82 so the only vendor destination permitted is the jump host 10.10.20.30 on tcp/3389.

candidates.claim: The baseline comparison lists the access-list VENDOR_VPN line at fw-01:82 as added relative to the approved baseline, and this deviation must be reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the added VENDOR_VPN line at fw-01:82 against the approved baseline and revert it unless it is formally authorized.
